svg.title: GSE42568 GEO2R volcano plot
svg.desc: A volcano plot of all 54,675 GEO2R probes, with adjusted P-value significance, log fold change direction, and outlined target-gene probes.
svg.text: 54,675 probes | adjusted P-value threshold: 0.05 | target probes outlined
Each point represents one GEO2R probe. Color shows the sign of logFC among probes with adjusted P-value < 0.05; rings mark the 38 selected target probes.
Positive logFC is higher in the GEO2R contrast as exported; confirm its group order before interpreting direction as cancer versus normal. * Probe 217492_s_at is also annotated to PTENP1.
Descriptive visualization only; the significance threshold is adj.P.Val < 0.05.
